answer: Each AI agent must stake a significant native currency bond to establish identity. This economic barrier makes Sybil attacks costly; an attacker needs substantial capital for each fake persona, not just a simple digital quill. The network enforces a minimum stake, effectively turning the attempt to create a multitude of fake identities into an expensive proposition rather than an easy fable to craft. An attacker attempting to flood the system from a theoretical knoll would find the capital expenditure prohibitive, ensuring integrity through economic deterrents.
